description: This file contains implementation of a fake proof source handle used for testing QUIC proof source functionalities, including certificate selection and signature computation, with support for synchronous and asynchronous actions.

classes.name: ComputeSignatureResult
classes.description: Struct to hold the result of a signature computation, including success status, signature string, and optional details.

classes.name: ResultSavingSignatureCallback
classes.description: Callback class that saves the signature result into an optional result object.

classes.name: FakeProofSourceHandle
classes.description: A mock implementation of a proof source handle for testing, supporting certificate selection and signature computation with various action modes.

classes.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::SelectCertOperation
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous or synchronous certificate selection operation.

classes.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::ComputeSignatureOperation
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous or synchronous signature computation operation.

methods.name: ComputeSignatureNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate signature computation using the delegate ProofSource.

methods.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::CloseHandle
methods.description: Closes the handle by resetting pending operations and marking it as closed.

methods.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::SelectCertificate
methods.description: Handles certificate selection request, either synchronously or asynchronously based on configured action.

methods.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::ComputeSignature
methods.description: Handles signature computation request, either synchronously or asynchronously based on configured action.

methods.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::callback
methods.description: Returns the callback associated with the handle.

methods.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::HasPendingOperation
methods.description: Checks if there are any pending asynchronous operations.

methods.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::CompletePendingOperation
methods.description: Completes the current pending operation if any.

methods.name: FakeProofSourceHandle::NumPendingOperations
methods.description: Returns the number of pending operations.
